_comment: kovanica-chain SEPOLIA TESTNET (Stage 2) intent. Human-readable target parameters; the actual deployment is driven by op-deployer (see deploy/sepolia/). This is a PUBLIC testnet: ownership must be SAFE-based and a chain-security-auditor pass is required before deploying (CLAUDE.md §3). Values with 0x0000… are placeholders you MUST fill.
_l2ChainID_note: Placeholder — choose a unique L2 chain id and (if joining the Superchain) reserve/register it before public launch. Must differ from the devnet id (2900).
_respectedGameType_note: Bootstrap on 1 (PermissionedDisputeGame) per the standard OP Stack bring-up order, then flip to 0 (permissionless CANNON) once op-dispute-mon shows healthy games and the challenger reliably resolves them.
_faultGameAbsolutePrestate_note: Regenerate the Cannon64 prestate for the SEPOLIA genesis/rollup (scripts/gen-prestate.sh) — the devnet prestate does NOT apply here.
_timers_note: Moderately shortened (~1h) for testnet iteration. Production/mainnet standard for contrast: faultGameWithdrawalDelay 604800, proofMaturityDelaySeconds 604800, disputeGameFinalityDelaySeconds 302400, faultGameClockExtension 10800, faultGameMaxClockDuration 302400.
_ownership_note: proxyAdminOwner/systemConfigOwner/guardian MUST be SAFE (smart-contract) accounts, never the deployer EOA. Keep the guardian (controls pause, dispute-game blacklist, respected-game-type) distinct from the deployer, which retains no control after deployment.
